importExport.title: Import & Export
importExport.syncNote: Sync your config to Ghostty's config file
importExport.writeNote: Write your current config directly to Ghostty's config file
importExport.pasteNote: Paste a config copied to your clipboard
importExport.pickFile: Pick a config file from your device
importExport.uploadFile: Upload a config file from your device
importExport.copyNote: Copy your config to the clipboard to paste elsewhere
importExport.saveNote: Save as a config file anywhere on your device
importExport.downloadNote: Save as a config file you can place in Ghostty's config directory
importExport.shareNote: Generate a link others can use to import your config
importExport.clipboardPasteError: Clipboard access failed! Please paste manually or import from file.
importExport.clipboardCopyError: Clipboard access failed! Please copy manually or export to file.
importExport.launchNote: Ghostty has no plugin system. Add a keybinding to your Ghostty config that launches this app, then open it with a shortcut:
importExport.launchMacSnippet: keybind = super+u { action = "run"; program = "open"; args = ["-a", "Ghostty Config"] }
importExport.launchWindowsSnippet: keybind = super+u { action = "run"; program = "C:\\Program Files\\Ghostty Config\\Ghostty Config.exe" }
importExport.launchSnippetNote: Add this line to your Ghostty config (config key: keybind). Ghostty has no plugin system — this keybind is the way to launch the app from inside Ghostty.

styles.title: Styles
styles.admonition: Styles are complete Ghostty config presets. Applying one merges its settings into your current config, so review the diff before you apply.
styles.starterNote: Bundled presets that reference the synced theme catalog.
styles.communityNote: Synced from {link}. Unsafe options are stripped before a style can be applied.
styles.communityEmpty: Community styles sync from ghostty.style. The catalog is empty until the next sync run.

Use this page to test your locally installed fonts as they may look in the terminal along with colors and glyphs.

keybinds.intro: If you're not familiar with keybinds, refer to {link}.
keybinds.confirmMessage: This will reset all keybinds to their defaults.
keybinds.keyNameNote: The key to use for this action.
keybinds.keyNameNoteN: The key to use for step {index} in the sequence.
keybinds.name: Name
keybinds.nameNote: The action to perform when the keybind is triggered.
keybinds.argumentNote: Optional argument for the action, format depends on the action type.

actions.ignore: Ignore this key and do not forward it to the terminal.
actions.unbind: Remove a previously defined Ghostty or user keybind.
actions.csi: Send a CSI sequence without the ESC[ prefix.
actions.text: Send literal text using Zig string literal syntax.
actions.cursor_key: Send cursor-key data based on normal or application mode.
actions.copy_to_clipboard: Copy selection to clipboard as plain, vt, html, or mixed.
actions.copy_url_to_clipboard: Copy URL under cursor to clipboard.
actions.increase_font_size: Increase font size by a point amount.
actions.decrease_font_size: Decrease font size by a point amount.
actions.reset_font_size: Reset font size to configured default.
actions.set_font_size: Set font size to a point value.
actions.search: Start or replace search text; use empty text to clear terms.
actions.search_selection: Search using the current text selection.
actions.navigate_search: Jump to previous or next search match.
actions.start_search: Open search UI without setting search text.
actions.end_search: End active search and hide search UI.
actions.scroll_to_selection: Scroll viewport to the current selection.
actions.scroll_to_row: Scroll to an absolute row index starting at 0.
actions.scroll_page_fractional: Scroll by a fractional page amount.
actions.scroll_page_lines: Scroll by a number of lines.
actions.adjust_selection: Adjust the current selection in a direction.
actions.jump_to_prompt: Jump viewport by prompt count (requires shell integration).
actions.write_scrollback_file: Write full scrollback to temp file and copy, paste, or open its path.
actions.write_screen_file: Write current screen to temp file and copy, paste, or open its path.
actions.write_selection_file: Write selection to temp file and copy, paste, or open its path.
actions.move_tab: Move current tab by relative offset.
actions.new_split: Create a split in a direction or auto.
actions.goto_split: Focus split by direction or previous/next order.
actions.toggle_split_zoom: Zoom or unzoom the current split.
actions.toggle_readonly: Toggle read-only mode for the focused surface.
actions.resize_split: Resize split by direction and pixel offset.
actions.equalize_splits: Equalize all split sizes in the window.
actions.inspector: Toggle, show, or hide terminal inspector.
actions.open_config: Open Ghostty config in default editor.
actions.reload_config: Reload configuration and apply runtime-safe changes.
actions.close_surface: Close focused surface (window, tab, split, etc.).
actions.close_tab: Close this tab, other tabs, or tabs to the right.
actions.toggle_secure_input: Toggle secure input mode for sensitive typing.
actions.toggle_mouse_reporting: Toggle whether mouse events are reported to terminal apps.
actions.toggle_visibility: Show or hide all Ghostty windows.
actions.toggle_background_opacity: Toggle between transparent and opaque window background.
actions.end_key_sequence: End active key sequence and flush prior keys.
actions.activate_key_table: Activate a named key table until deactivated.
actions.activate_key_table_once: Activate a named key table for one successful keybind use.
actions.crash: Force a crash in selected thread for testing.
